working_definition: Author type 'TmY4' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary Y neuron TmY4 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Slp/D temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'TmY4' is FBbt:00003821 'transmedullary Y neuron TmY4'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00052338 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary Y wide-field neuron that terminates with both fine and bleb-type arborizations in lobula layer 4 and in lobula plate layers 2, 3 and 4, but shows only fine arborizations in lobula plate layer 1. It displays both fine and bleb-type arborizations in medulla layer M8, but has only fine arborizations in medulla layer M3 and M4 (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It is cholinergic (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052338 'immature transmedullary Y neuron TmY4' (exact match).
